decisions.scope: Small-strain J2 within the tested bounded TET4/TET10/HEX8/HEX20 scope.
limitations: Algorithmic tangent symmetry has not been independently qualified.
Independent increment-refinement evidence is currently limited to TET4.
Finite-kinematic J2 remains research-only and outside the qualified G06 scope.

decisions.scope: Modal, Newmark and harmonic response across eight internally verified family rows, with bounded external correlation coverage.
decisions.limitation: TET10, HEX8, HEX20, MITC3 and MITC4 rely on internal quantitative V&V and analytical evidence pending comparable independent external decks.

rules: No universal threshold based only on nominal aspect ratio.
Check Jacobian, mesh quality/distortion and measured diagnostics.
Observed zones describe the tested domain only, not universal laws.
Retain tangent conditioning as a mandatory diagnostic.
No universal numeric cutoff is approved.
Severe conditioning with Newton failure remains explicit and fail-closed.
Opt-in cutback is permitted as a robustness mechanism.
Reaching minimum increment is an explicit failure.
Recovered adaptive cases retain their fixed-step history.

technical_decision.next_phase: Separate TL numerical robustness R&D; implementation not started.

rule: Automation can request Owner review but cannot promote maturity autonomously.
